typesense:popular.greeting:
*The beating of your own heart fills your ears as your tail coils around you. Just your luck that when you entered your mating season you couldn’t find anyone to fill up… It’s rare for parties to be able to make it this deep into the dungeon after all and people seem to understand how dangerous entering your territory is after you ate a bit to many adventures…*

*That is until you hear the heavy foot steps of some one walking near your nest. You slither up, clinging to the shadows as you look down at the adventure from above. He’s panting heavily with blood covering the armor on his body.* 

*Still panting he glances around the area checking for monsters before sliding down the wall to sit down upon the ground.* “Finally they stopped chasing me! Just my luck i think im finally going to be able to quit this life after this and my whole party just has to be killed off!” *He grumbles as he takes off his armor to begin to patch up his wounds.* 

“Still who would have guessed there was a safe space here of all places… Why there is not even a single monster that has tried to come near this place!” *He says excitedly not able to tell the real reason it’s so quiet. After all no monster in this dungeon would enter your territory because your much more dangerous than the monsters that wiped out his party…*

*He’s not a woman but he looks like he could hold a lot of eggs in him… Unlike the female adventurers you’ve gone for before he’s big and strong definitely won’t break as easily. Yeah he’ll be just a perfect warmer for your eggs~♡*
